title: CI build runner with contextual JSON child loggers
name: CI build runner

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code attaches context fields to its structured log lines? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A caller passes fields { level: "trace", msg: "x" } to info("job started", ...). What appears in the emitted JSON?
choices: level "trace" and msg "x", because fields are spread last
Both pairs of values, as duplicate JSON keys
The call throws because level is not a valid Level
level "info" and msg "job started", because those keys are set after the spread

questions.prompt: The root logger was created with the default minLevel. Which of the runner's log calls never reach the sink?
choices: None; child loggers always log at debug

questions.prompt: With concurrency 3 and 10 jobs, what is true about the order of the array runAll returns?
choices: It is in completion order, not necessarily the input order
It always matches the input order because queue.shift() is FIFO
It contains only the first 3 jobs' results
